zh.export.md:
# 导出与删除申请

工作区管理员可从数据管理页导出 CSV。删除申请先由管理员确认，再由服务台核实身份后排队处理。导出下载链接在二十四小时后失效，链接失效不等于原数据已删除。
zh.roles.md:
# 成员角色与授权

工作区管理员邀请成员并分配角色。分析员可查看报表但不能邀请成员；访客只能查看获授权的看板。调整角色后应复核访问范围。本文没有规定审计日志保留年限。
zh.quota.md:
# API 用量配额

每个工作区独立统计 API 请求次数，失败请求也计入用量。达到分钟配额时返回限流响应，客户端应按响应提示退避，不能立即循环重发。配额窗口结束后重新计数。
zh.keys.md:
# API 密钥轮换

管理员先创建替代密钥，更新客户端配置并验证成功，再撤销旧密钥。密钥只应保存在秘密管理器中，禁止把密钥正文发送到客服工单或群聊。
zh.maintenance.md:
# 计划维护通知

计划维护安排在周日凌晨的低峰窗口。服务台提前通过站内公告和订阅邮件通知工作区管理员。紧急故障另发状态通知，计划维护窗口不是恢复时限承诺。本文没有留存率实验。
zh.tickets.md:
# 客服工单交接

服务台轮班时交接未关闭的工单。交接记录包含问题摘要、已尝试步骤和下一位负责人；附件应移除个人信息和访问凭据。交接流程不规定产品订阅价格。

en.keys.md:
# API key rotation

Create a replacement key, update clients, verify access, then revoke the old key. Keep secrets in a secret manager, never in support tickets.
en.status.md:
# Service status

The status page announces planned maintenance and incidents. Subscribers receive notices. A maintenance notice is not a recovery-time guarantee.

scoring.positive: Return every labeled source and at least one chunk from it; valid citations alone do not prove relevance
scoring.negative: No returned chunks; any nonempty hit is recorded as an irrelevant-hit failure
scoring.recall: Relevant chunk hits divided by all chunks of labeled short sources; null for empty Gold
scoring.precision: Relevant chunk hits divided by returned unique chunks; null when no hits
scoring.source: Distinct source identities, never number of chunks
scoring.mrr: First relevant returned chunk reciprocal rank, zero on missed positives, null on negatives
scoring.layers: retrieval/citation/goal relevance only; Worker completion, Report and live model behavior not measured
scoring.quality_gate: All positives have full source coverage, all negatives empty, and no irrelevant hits anywhere; failures retained, not a pytest pass criterion
